videos.desc: In a hand-painted animation, an elderly woman and a big bearded man walk backward down an autumn park avenue, arms out for balance, glancing over their shoulders while a duck watches; they finish with a high five.
videos.said: Don't look! Just walk! I told you!

videos.desc: Three cartoon commuters wait impatiently under a bus-stop shelter on a foggy street; an orange double-decker bus finally pulls up, they board, and the bus drives off leaving the stop empty.
videos.said: Ten more minutes! Fininally, here it comes!

videos.desc: A man shows how to cross a city street: first he walks while staring at his phone and gets a big red WRONG mark, then he looks left and right and walks on the white crosswalk lines, earning green CORRECT ticks and giving a thumbs up.
videos.said: How do I cross the street? First, I look left and right. Then I cross on the white lines. Now, I cross safely.

videos.desc: From inside the car, a woman's hands guide the steering wheel along an empty coastal road, easing smoothly through a bend with the sea ahead. She parks, and her passenger turns around smiling to praise the smooth drive.
videos.said: Easy through the bend. Smoothest park ever.

videos.desc: A bearded man in blue swim shorts lies on his back on a calm mountain lake, arms spread wide, floating peacefully. A small yellow bird lands on his belly and then his head, and he grins and gives a thumbs up.
videos.said: Oh !

videos.desc: In a 3D-animated town, a girl in a red raincoat steps out of a blue door with her bag, waves "Bye! See you!" to her mother and goes off down the colorful cobblestone street.
videos.said: Bye! See you!

videos.desc: In a Pixar-style animation, a smiling pilot lifts off from a mountain helipad in a red helicopter, lowers a wooden crate on a cable to a cheering older couple at an alpine hut, then flies away past a snowy peak.
videos.said: (dramatic music) - Woo hoo! (upbeat music) - Hey! (dramatic music)

videos.desc: Helmet-camera view from a rider riding a sport motorcycle down an empty country road between green hedges; the handlebars and dashboard are visible as cars pass in the opposite lane.
On a hand-painted seaside terrace, a dance teacher leads a line of villagers; they all point their arms to the left and step together in that direction, repeating the side-steps as a group.
videos.said: And step this side. Step together. Step, step. Other side. That way.

videos.desc: In a colorful cartoon beach town a young woman carefully steers her teal car into a street parking space between two cars, turns the key off, and steps out beaming while a man on the curb applauds her neat parking.
videos.said: Easy! Easy! Nope! Ta-da!

videos.desc: Two young men lean into the back doors of a white van on a residential street, counting and pushing with all their strength. The van slowly rolls away down the road and they stand up, laugh and high-five.
videos.said: One, two, push! It's moving!

videos.desc: At an animated night street market a food-cart vendor gives a lost backpacker directions, pointing firmly to the right past the stalls; he starts off the wrong way, she spins him around to the correct side, and he heads off right with a thumbs-up.
videos.said: That way! Pass the fountain! Thank you! No, no! This side! Aha!

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime park scene, a girl in a blue dress sprints at full speed across the grass chasing her straw hat as the wind blows it away; she dives, tumbles, pins the hat down and puts it back on with a triumphant smile.
videos.said: No! Wait! Got it!

videos.desc: From inside a yellow taxi, the driver weaves through busy city traffic and squeezes the cab through an impossibly narrow alley between buildings, then grins back at his passenger, proud of the shortcut.
videos.said: [MUSIC PLAYING] This taxi driver deserves a tip.

videos.desc: In a colorful hillside street, two girls on a balcony haul a fruit basket up on a rope while their friend below cheers. She then climbs up a tall ladder to join them, and together they watch a hot-air balloon rise up into the sky.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Higher! Oh my gosh!

videos.desc: A young woman waits for the bus at a bus stop, getting more and more bored: she checks her phone, slumps, lies upside down across the bench and hugs her knees. At last the bus appears down the road and she jumps up, smiling.
videos.said: I wait for the bus. I look at the time. I wait and wait.

videos.desc: A woman in a cream sweatsuit walks along a path through a sunny city park by a lake, filmed from behind and beside her. A jogger runs past, the skyline shows across the water, and she turns to the camera, smiles and waves as she keeps walking.
videos.said: [Music] I like to walk. I walk in the park every day.

videos.desc: Filmed over a car bonnet on a dirt track running between tall golden reeds at sunset. A mint-green scooter rides ahead with two small dogs aboard, one in a blue cap. The dogs hop down and mill about on the track, then climb back on and the scooter tips over into the reeds at the edge.

A small white propeller plane is airborne over a city, with a river and a distant skyline behind it and rows of houses far below. A woman in a pink shirt sits in the open doorway, then steps out onto the wing and stands upright with her arms spread wide while the plane keeps flying. She crouches back down, holds the wing with both hands and climbs back inside. The plane flies on alone with the pilot visible in the cockpit.

A brown and white bulldog rides away from the camera on a small skateboard along the wet road of a campsite lined with parked caravans and pickup trucks. It pushes with one back leg past an American flag and a big mossy oak, gets smaller in the distance, then swings round and comes back the other way. In the last shot it rides straight towards the camera with its tongue out.
videos.said: You go. All right, we're going right, Grayson, this way. All right, let's go get a treat.

videos.desc: A first-person view looks down at the filmer's own feet in black sandals on an outdoor water obstacle course, above a pool of green water. He steps from one floating blue and white block to the next along a line of them, arms out to keep his balance. He crosses a narrow beam, then reaches a tall red tower covered in scale-shaped panels and takes hold of a thick white rope with both hands to pull himself up. At the top he stands behind a red railing looking down over the whole course.
videos.said: Help, help, help!

videos.desc: A helmet-camera view from a road bike at sunset. The rider's tanned arms grip the drop handlebars, and ahead of them a long, steep flight of worn stone steps drops away down the face of a red cliff towards the sea. The sun sits low on the horizon, laying a golden path across the water. The bike bumps down step after step, the stone blurring beneath the front wheel, until the steps end and the rider rolls out onto a dark dirt path by a low stone wall.

A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a dry dirt jump park under a blue sky. Ahead of the camera another rider hurtles up a huge sloping ramp of packed orange earth and launches high into the air, hanging above the ridge. The point-of-view rider races after him down the trail, the ground blurring past the front tyre as he drops through bermed corners and along the side of a green and brown hill, chasing the rider ahead across the jumps.

Filmed through a car windscreen in slow traffic on a busy city street under a concrete overpass, with shops and signs along the roadside. Ahead, a motorbike carries a tall stack of mattresses with a brown street dog riding on top. The load slides off and lands flat on the tarmac, and the dog jumps down and stands beside it. A man in a red shirt helps the rider heave the mattresses back onto the bike. As soon as they are strapped on, the dog climbs back up on top and the motorbike pulls away through the traffic.
videos.said: I'm telling you. Look at this. He's mad at the dog for dropping the mattress. Now they load it back up. And look, the dog hops right back on. There they go.

videos.desc: At night in an empty car park in front of a fast-food restaurant, a man in a dark hoodie and cap runs towards a lit-up yellow arch sign. He grabs the sign, pulls it free and hurries back across the tarmac carrying the big yellow piece under his arm. He shoves it through the door of a waiting car, climbs in after it, and the last shot is his face inside the car, laughing, with the yellow sign filling half the frame.
videos.said: Start the car, go, go, go!

videos.desc: Filmed from inside a car driving on a highway, the shot looks over the bonnet at a bright blue sports car with a big rear wing driving in the same lane ahead. The highway runs straight ahead with white lane markings and a metal crash barrier on the left, green fields and villages on both sides. In front of them stands a wall of grey rocky mountains with snow on the peaks and a long white band of cloud lying across the slopes.

A point-of-view shot from someone hanging in a harness, with their bare legs and blue-soled trainers dangling in the bottom of the frame. They sweep fast over a steep green mountain meadow, the grass blurring underneath them, and then the ground drops away and they are flying high above a valley. Dark pine forest runs down both sides, a small road winds through the fields below, and the grey rocky peaks of the Dolomites stand against a deep blue sky.

A red sports car with a big black rear wing stands on a narrow strip of tarmac running through orange desert sand, with electricity pylons along the horizon. The car accelerates hard away from the camera and throws up an enormous cloud of orange sand behind it that fills the whole screen. As the sand thins out the car is only a small red dot far down the road, and in the last shot the sand and haze have swallowed it completely and the road is empty.

A green Lamborghini takes a corner on a race circuit, running over the red-and-white kerb. A close-up then fills the frame with one spinning black wheel: a big red brake caliper is clamped on the dark disc behind the spokes and the yellow wheel-nut turns in the middle. The car is seen from behind on the damp track with its wide rear wing, and the camera finally pans off into a blur of grass and tarmac.

A young blond man, filmed from the passenger seat of a sports car, drives along a mountain road while he talks; through the side window beside him the trees and the verge rush past as a green blur. The shot cuts outside to a yellow supercar coming fast round a bend below a rock face and a wall of pine forest, then back to him at the wheel.
videos.said: The most important thing is the connection with the car. Every action gets an immediate response. This thing is pure fun, like entering a different dimension.

videos.desc: Outside a stone villa with clipped hedges in the evening sun, a man in a black tank top walks up to a red Ferrari, opens the low door and lowers himself into the red leather seat. A close-up shows his hand on the switches beside the steering wheel and the lit instrument dials. He then sits behind the wheel, looking straight ahead through the windscreen.

On a large mown lawn at golden hour, a grown woman in sunglasses, a white t-shirt and white trainers sits in a tiny pink toy jeep, far too small for her, with her legs folded up over the bonnet. She drives it slowly across the grass past a huge old oak tree, filmed from a vehicle following behind her. She steers around, waves an arm, and carries on away from the camera towards a weeping willow, a row of tall poplars and two wooden sheds in the evening light.
videos.said: Thank you.
